actual_checks: Read full official underdetermined source statement and A1 unit-task schedule. New interface explicitly requires positive rational durations, atomic nonpreemptive jobs, identical processors, zero communication and acyclic finish-before-start precedence; cyclic numerical iteration is not silently modeled.

Reconstructed latest-finishing-predecessor chain from the final job. In every gap before/between its jobs, the next chain job is ready so all processors are busy; every underfull interval is covered by a chain job. Integrating work gives W>=p(T-U)+U with U<=D, and hence the stated refined bound and2-1/p ratio.

Checked empty input, p=1, simultaneous completions, cycle infeasibility by positive-duration sum and large binary p capped to n. Event scheduler uses at most polynomially many heap updates and exact comparisons; common denominator and sums keep event times/output polynomial in input bits. No unary time expansion or scheduler execution claimed.

scope_assessment: For finite atomic jobs with positive rational durations and a directed acyclic finish-before-start dependency graph, deterministic nonpreemptive list scheduling on p identical processors has makespan≤W/p+(1−1/p)D≤(2−1/p)OPT. Cyclic dependencies are detected as infeasible in this model; unspecified iterative grid semantics are not silently supplied.
